title: Integration Sync — Wire 17 ACP+MXU Engines into Full System Surface
brief: 17 engines built (ACP-MS0→MS7 + MXU-MS0A→MS10) with 57 dispatcher actions and 365 tests. ZERO are wired into hooks, slash commands, CLAUDE.md, ENGINE_DIGEST, skills, or existing automation flows. This milestone wires everything into the full system surface so capabilities auto-fire and are discoverable.

knowledge_sources.claude_md: H:/prism/CLAUDE.md (project instructions, no mention of 17 new engines)

phases.title: Document Sync — Digests, CLAUDE.md, Memory, Position

sessions.title: Document & Index Synchronization
sessions.intent: Every system document accurately reflects the 17 new engines and 57 new actions. Claude/Codex sessions can discover them via digest lookup.

units.title: Update ENGINE_DIGEST.md with 17 new engine entries
units.description: Add one-line descriptions for all 17 ACP+MXU engines to ENGINE_DIGEST.md in correct alphabetical/domain position

units.title: Update DISPATCHER_DIGEST.md with 57 new actions
units.description: Add all 57 new devDispatcher actions to DISPATCHER_DIGEST.md with action names and brief descriptions

units.title: Update CLAUDE.md Architecture section
units.description: Add ACP and MXU to the Architecture section. Add automation chains, capability census, product pillars to 'What's Built' section. Update engine/dispatcher/action counts.

sessions.title: Wire BuildGuard + Context + TokenEconomy into Hooks
sessions.intent: Hooks auto-fire the new engines on every edit, search, and compaction — no manual invocation needed.

units.title: Replace enforce-smart-test-after-edit.py with BuildGuardChainEngine hook
units.description: New PostToolUse hook on Write|Edit that calls BuildGuardChainEngine.trackEdit() and resolveAffectedTests(). Replace the Python script with a Node.js hook that imports the engine directly.

units.title: Wire ContextChainEngine into PreCompact hook
units.description: PreCompact hook calls ContextChainEngine.planCompaction() to determine what to preserve. Outputs critical facts to HANDOFF.md.
exit_criteria: Handoff includes critical_facts from context chain

units.title: Wire TokenEconomyEngine into PostToolUse tracking
units.description: PostToolUse hook records token spending per tool call category. Session summary available via /token-economy.
exit_criteria: Token spending tracked per tool call

sessions.title: Wire AutomationChain + CodingCopilot into Prompt/Edit Hooks
sessions.intent: Every user prompt is auto-classified into a task class. Every engine edit triggers dedup check. Chain failures get structured recovery.

units.title: Wire AutomationChainEngine into UserPromptSubmit hook
units.description: Classify each prompt into one of 9 task classes. Inject context bundles for the detected class. Log classification for telemetry.

units.title: Wire CodingCopilotEngine dedup check into PreToolUse Write|Edit for engine files
units.description: Before creating a new engine file, check for duplication against existing engines. Warn if overlap > 60%.
exit_criteria: New engine file creation triggers dedup check

units.title: Wire ChainFailureRecoveryEngine into PostToolUseFailure hook
units.description: When a tool call fails, classify the failure and compute a recovery plan. Inject retry/skip/abort guidance.

sessions.title: Create New Slash Commands for MXU Engines
sessions.intent: Users can type /discover, /census, /pillar, /token-economy, /learn-path and get rich output from the new engines.

units.title: Create /discover skill
units.description: Skill that calls DiscoverabilityEngine.search() or .whatCanIDo(). Shows capability matches with entry points.

units.title: Create /census skill
units.description: Skill that runs CapabilityCensusEngine.runLiveReport(). Shows utilization %, dark engines, gaps.

units.title: Create /pillar skill
units.description: Skill that calls ProductPillarEngine.getSummary(). Shows 8 product pillars with completeness scores.

phases.title: Existing Command Updates — Startup, Compact, Forge

sessions.title: Update Startup, Compact, Forge Commands
sessions.intent: Existing commands leverage new engines automatically. Startup shows census. Compact uses context chain. Forge uses copilot.

units.title: Update /startup to show pillar summary + census snapshot
units.description: Add Step 4F to startup that calls ProductPillarEngine.getSummary() and shows pillar readiness. Add utilization % from census.

units.title: Update /precompact to use ContextChainEngine
units.description: Precompact calls ContextChainEngine.planCompaction() and includes critical_facts in handoff output.

units.title: Update /forge-engines to use CodingCopilot dedup + template
units.description: Before creating any engine, forge calls CodingCopilotEngine.checkDuplication() and .generateTemplate(). Shows reuse suggestions.
exit_criteria: Forge shows dedup check before creating

sessions.title: Update Memory, Position, State Files
sessions.intent: All state files reflect the completed ACP and MXU tracks. Memory records the architectural decisions. Position updated.

units.title: Update MEMORY.md with ACP+MXU completion
units.description: Add memory entries for: ACP track complete (7 engines, 22 actions), MXU track complete (10 engines, 35 actions), key architectural decisions.

units.title: Update CURRENT_POSITION.md and roadmap-index.json
units.description: Mark ACP-MS0 through MS7 complete. Mark MXU-MS0A through MS10 complete. Update milestone counts.

units.title: Update AUTOMATION_CENSUS.json + MASTER_INDEX_COMPACT.md
units.description: Refresh automation census with all new engines/actions. Update master index with new engine/dispatcher/action counts.

criteria: CLAUDE.md updated with ACP+MXU in Architecture section
6 hooks auto-fire (build-guard, context-chain, token-economy, prompt-classifier, copilot-dedup, chain-recovery)
